# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035), [v3 c41 P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette presents a tidy, practical, and unadorned appearance. She has plump hands, on which her diamond cluster engagement ring resembled a bandage. On her wedding day, she wore white satin, tulle, lace, roses, orange blossoms, and diamonds.

_Sources: [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c41 P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009)_

## Personality

Odette is unassuming, hardworking, dutiful, steady, and sensible, possessing an unshakeable composure during examinations. She is regarded by her peers as lady-like, practical, pragmatic, and unpretentious. Although she takes her teaching obligations seriously and performs them thoroughly, she privately finds the work tedious and punishes pupils who make humorous remarks. Despite her levelheaded disposition, she harbors a quiet envy for luxurious wealth and romantic adventures.

_Sources: [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c33 P41](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0041), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## History

Odette grew up in Brierley as the daughter of Gorham Pullen. After completing her early schooling under Miss Thorne, she attended Regent's Academy alongside her local peers to obtain her teaching credentials, earning top marks in domestic science. Upon qualifying, she secured her first teaching position in Stonebridge, where her work earned her high regard. Outside of her classroom duties, she actively participated in the Brierley Village Improvement Society, heading a fundraising committee and supporting petitions to local trustees. She later transferred to teach at Brierley school before taking a post on western prairie schools. While living in the West, she became engaged to Mr. Inglis, a wealthy Englishman from Winnipeg. She returned home to Brierley and married him at the end of May in a grand ceremony before moving to Winnipeg.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 c7 P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v2 c14 P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035), [v3 c41 P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009)_

- nearly drowned gathered water lilies during a boat trip on the Lake of Glassy Waters before her father saved her  <sub>[v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>

## Quotes

> Wasn’t that an absolutely marvelous occasion? If only I were a wealthy American who could pass the summer months residing in a hotel, donning gems and decollete gowns, and eating chicken salad along with ice cream each and every day. That must be vastly superior to working as a teacher.  <sub>[v1 c33 P41](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0041)</sub>

> However, what if they fail to do so?  <sub>[v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008)</sub>

> I wish fairies actually existed. Would it not be lovely if a person could have three wishes fulfilled . . . or perhaps just one? What wish would you make, girls, if a wish were granted to you? My wish would be for wealth, beauty, and intelligence.  <sub>[v2 c13 P32](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0032)</sub>

> Barney desires to make you his wife. He has perpetually been mad about you—and currently father has bestowed the upper farm upon him under his own name, so there is no obstacle to stop him from taking a bride. However, he is so bashful that he was unable to inquire directly whether you would take him, which led him to persuade me to act on his behalf. I would have preferred not to, but he harassed me incessantly until I promised that I would, provided a suitable opportunity arose. What is your opinion on the matter, Nell?  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
